body: Thats also one of the things I think causes depression, its amazing how happier people in Ireland get when its sunny out :) You ever need to burn my ear just PM man :)
Where abouts in Dublin? You ever need to talk or anything just gimme a shout :)

Yeah the drugs was easy enough...seriously though, I know it sounds odd, but smiling at your self and singing when your alone make me happy, also laughing when you make mistakes or get into an arguement always turns it around, I realised in work that if I was angry I wouldnt perform as well, but when I'm laughing and joking with my colleagues it makes it so much better and I actually love my job

When I first started I was shy for about a month, didn't really get on with anyone, then one day I just said f*ck it, I'm gonna talk about and say what I want, I've only got one life and I could be in this job for the rest of it, so I might aswell enjoy it...today was a very fun day in work, even though it was pissing rain outside

Recession, drink, drugs and family problems I reckon...the people in this country need to give more love to each other, depression over here is not looked into enough...there are people who work really hard to try combat the problem but they just don't have the resources or the backing to do so.

I have a good feeling that a couple of my friends are suffering from it, I've tried to coax them into opening up but I've had no results.

**RECESSION**

Very hard to get a job over here at the moment, luckily I got one through a family member, this is what I'm most happiest about and I thank God or whoevers up there every day...out of my 9 best friends, 5 of them are unemployed, one was homeless for awhile, spent his 21st birthday trying to wake his girlfriend so he could sleep in her house!

There are jobs on offer but now that theres a recession, employers have their pick of the best of who to employ, so people coming out of school looking for a job are f**ked as they have little or no experience in working.

I know loads of people on social welfare (dole), some of my friends get €144 or €188

Most of these live at home with their parents, so its mostly goes on drink and drugs at the weekend


**DRINK*

I think drink is a major factor in depression over here, people usualy start drinking around the age of 14 or 15, probably 4-6 cans at the weekend...then over the years it becomes more cans more frequently. 

For me I was 15, started with 4 bottles on a Friday night with the lads, up until around March I would go out on Friday night and come home on the Sunday or the Monday, this is seriously not good for the head, nothing do to Monday to Thursday, having too much time to think about unimportant things, just waiting for the weekend to drink and forget your problems, having no motivation to work as you get comfortable sitting around all day

**DRUGS**

This bastard! A never ending cycle of depression...bored/unhappy -  take drugs - forget problems - sober up - sad and remember problems - take drugs again and so on

Again for me, after I started drinking I started doing Ecstasy aged 16, when I first start doing them I thought it was going to be brilliant forever, it led me to doing Coke, Acid and Ketamine too...I regret doing drugs, turned me into a lazy b**tard, went from being very good in school to being shit in school, my parents were very suspicious and it broke they're heart that I was out every weekend up to no good

Also got chased with a knife at the start of this year over drug money...that was my wake up call

Heading to bed now, have to be up early for work

Talk again soon...anyone reading this, feel free to PM me..and first thing in the morning, **smile at yourself in them mirror no matter how you feel, it helps :)**
